scope: Delivery-only missing-policy resume, unchanged-support aggregation and frozen signed arm2 necessary guardrail screen. No package, detector, independent-confirmation or release approval.
checks: Previous writer completed before non-forced ref update; completed, partial or failed configurations are not overwritten.
Original support source hashes, policies, seeds, masks, summaries and per-invocation containment remain fixed.
Control driver invokes the exact BalanceSim with empty bans, Policy.resolve({}), random_build=true and random_play=false, native shipping incentives and mature profile.
Control rectangle is neither the balanced research controller nor the old exposed 64-seed diagnostic.
Integer .5/.1 gates preserve exact boundaries; nominal bootstrap intervals are report-only.
Decoder tests reject missing/replaced seeds, policy drift, incorrect content and fabricated wins; compressed/uncompressed readouts agree.
Available raw and diagnostics survive failure; publication fetches and compares remote bytes in a separate Git repository.
limits: Support and signed controls are necessary evidence only. Independent complementarity, peer/policy separation, duration, policy ceiling, detector and retention remain open.
Postrun hashing is not independent semantic or runtime-provenance qualification.
A blocked recorded prefix is not failure of counterfactual reoptimisation.
A failed partial control capture may have rows not represented in its completed-row counter; retained raw and cell receipts govern exposure, not a default zero.
The historical original-arm archive still lacks full remote payload storage.
